subject: gk
question: Which of the following is an indirect tax?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goods and Services Tax**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GST **(Goods and Services Tax) is an **indirect tax**.
 
• It is levied on the **supply of goods and services**.
 
• **GST **introduced in India on **July 1, 2017**.
 
• **GST replaces **various **indirect taxes** like **VAT, excise duty, and service tax**.
 
• It is charged at **each stage **of the **production and distribution chain**.
 
• Ultimately, the burden of **GST** is passed on to the end consumer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Death duty**

 
 
• **Death duty** is a tax on assets transferred upon an **individual's death**.
 
• It's also referred to as **inheritance or estate tax**.
 
 
 
• **Interest tax** 
 
 
• **Interest tax **is levied on **interest income earned** from investments.
 
• It's a form of **direct tax **imposed by governments.
 
• Tax rates on interest income vary based on **jurisdiction and tax status**.
 
 
 
• **Capital gains tax**
 
 
• **Capital gains tax **is imposed on **profits from selling capital assets**.
 
• It applies when the** selling price exceeds** the **original purchase price**.
 
• It's a form of **direct tax**, paid by the taxpayer.
